lines.zh: 我的翅膀上画着眼睛，吓人用的。
lines.en: Eyes painted on my wings. For frightening.

lines.zh: 我飞得比普通蝶慢一点，故意的。
lines.en: Slower than a normal butterfly. On purpose.

lines.zh: 我沿着一排花飞，像在散步。
lines.en: I drift along a row of flowers. Strolling.
My wingbeat has a rhythm.
I circle a trunk, looking for an angle.

lines.zh: 这么大的蝶，飞起来遮光。
lines.en: A butterfly this size throws shade.

lines.zh: 我从你肩膀上方过去，很近。
lines.en: I pass above your shoulder. Close.

lines.zh: 我飞得很直，像有什么目的。
lines.en: I fly straight. Purposeful.
The pattern shows better at night.
My circles keep narrowing.

lines.zh: 翅膀的影子落在地上，像一大片叶。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground. Like a large leaf.

lines.zh: 我掠过凋灵玫瑰，不落下。
lines.en: I skim a wither rose without landing.

lines.zh: 我往高处飞，看清楚全貌。
lines.en: I climb high to see everything.
This isn't flight. It's patrol.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动的风，吹动了草。
lines.en: The wind off my wings bends the grass.

lines.zh: 我落在你的影子里，稍等一下。
lines.en: I land in your shadow. A moment.
I settle on a branch and fold slowly.

lines.zh: 外表的温顺，是装出来的。
lines.en: The gentleness is acting.

lines.zh: 我不需要花蜜，我只需要时机。
lines.en: I need no nectar. Only the right moment.
This wood is mine.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼，一直睁着。
lines.en: The eyes on my wings never close.
My lifespan has no end.

lines.zh: 等收走这具身体，我还能活很久。
lines.en: When this body's gone, I'll still be here.
I don't lay on dead leaves.

lines.zh: 安静，是猎物放松的时候。
lines.en: Quiet is when prey relaxes.
Counting the sun as it moves west.

lines.zh: 树上的其它蝶，我不理会。
lines.en: Other butterflies here. I ignore them.
One quiver and dust falls.
You think I'm pretty.
The longer you look, the closer I get.
This butterfly's eyes are on you.
You reach. I don't dodge.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀打开，看见了吗？
lines.en: I open my wings. See?
I like your expression.

lines.zh: 你以为能抓我，是很可爱。
lines.en: Thinking you can catch me. Cute.
I don't blink. No eyelids.
That net. So close.

lines.zh: 我们这类蝶，不与人交好。
lines.en: My kind doesn't befriend people.
Dust everywhere. Ugly.
A corner torn. It'll grow back.
I climb and reassess.
The eyespot is dented; I fly on.

lines.zh: 你的反应比我预想的快。
lines.en: Faster than I predicted.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，粉又起来了。
lines.en: I shook my wings. More dust.

lines.zh: 你打中了眼斑，那里最硬。
lines.en: You hit an eyespot. The hardest part.
I land on a branch and pause.
You still think I'm just a butterfly.
I circle to the far side of the tree.
Nectar? Insulting.
Holding out a flower. Funny.

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，我需要世界。
lines.en: I don't need food. I need the world.

lines.zh: 凋灵玫瑰也不行，我吸够了。
lines.en: Not even a wither rose. I've had enough.
Put it down and I'll consider.
I'm not tempted. I'm the lure.
That flower. Wrong color.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，只是想看清楚。
lines.en: A little closer. Just to look.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your hand shakes. Very clear.
That won't buy your life.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的翅膀，会沾粉。
lines.en: Hit my wing and you get dust on you.
I rise half a block to let you by.
Not large. Not soft.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我早就不在那了。
lines.en: You swatted. I'd already moved.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手指转了半圈。
lines.en: I circled your fingers half a turn.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我没影响，对你有点。
lines.en: Collisions don't affect me. You, somewhat.
Don't get close. The dust blinds.
I land back on your shoulder. Light.
You shouldn't be going that way.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我在你衣服上留了印。
lines.en: That left a mark on your clothes.
My kind discusses expansion only.

lines.zh: 我产卵在树叶上，一窝很多。
lines.en: Eggs on leaves. Many per clutch.

lines.zh: 我的幼虫会吃光一棵树。
lines.en: My larvae will strip a tree.

lines.zh: 我跟你不是同一种，别试。
lines.en: We're not the same species. Don't.
The looks are for prey.
I outlive this wood.

lines.zh: 你站远些，我翅膀打扰你。
lines.en: Stand back. My wings would bother you.
We don't pair up.

lines.zh: 毛虫出来的时候，你会跑。
lines.en: When the caterpillars come out, you'll run.
I decline that invitation.
I land and grip it with my legs.
This weight keeps me low.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我看了一眼。
lines.en: Something below. I looked once.

lines.zh: 这东西不是花，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Not a flower. No interest.
I carried it two blocks.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我拿去占领世界。
lines.en: I'll take what you dropped — and the world with it.
I tuck it under the bark.
This weight doesn't slow me.
Metal. I don't eat metal.

lines.zh: 我闻了一下，有一点点甜。
lines.en: One sniff. A little sweet.
I settle at the edge of your sight.
Nothing else in this wood.
My wings changed angle.
You're moving. That's enough to judge.
This butterfly has stopped pretending.
I circle to your front.

lines.zh: 你的汗味混着铁，我标记了。
lines.en: Your sweat and iron — I have marked the mix.
No other way out.
I counted your steps.
The sun on you. Bright.

lines.zh: 我慢慢贴近，翅膀不出声。
lines.en: Closing in. Wings silent.
You retreat. I go around ahead.

lines.zh: 我停在你够不到的高度。
lines.en: I hover just out of reach.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里，你一直在动。
lines.en: In my compound eyes, you never stop moving.

lines.zh: 你举起了网，我等它落下。
lines.en: Raise the net. I'll wait for it to fall.

lines.zh: 这片林子的每棵树，我都熟。
lines.en: I know every tree here.
My wing shadow is getting closer.

lines.zh: 你听见粉落在草上的声音吗？
lines.en: Hear the dust landing on the grass?

lines.zh: 你退到树根，那就没地方了。
lines.en: Back to the roots and there's nowhere left.
One more, and I descend.

lines.zh: 我撞在你后颈上，翅膀扇动。
lines.en: I hit your nape, wings beating.

lines.zh: 翅边的鳞粉迷了你的眼。
lines.en: Wing dust in your eyes.
Light, but on the mark.
I rested on your face for an instant.
You swatted. I went behind your ear.
Something this pretty bites.
I climb and find a new angle.
My wing edge crossed your skin.
The dust made you cough twice.
I settle on your shoulder. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我从一片宽叶下钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out from under a broad leaf.

lines.zh: 一只巨大的蝶，落在树梢。
lines.en: A huge butterfly lands in the canopy.

lines.zh: 翅膀展开的那一下，风都变了。
lines.en: When my wings opened, the wind changed.

lines.zh: 我不该出现在这里，但我来了。
lines.en: I shouldn't be here. I came anyway.

lines.zh: 我的粉在空中飘着很久。
lines.en: My dust hangs in the air a long while.
A pair of eyes in the bushes.
I circled three times before settling.

lines.zh: 这片林子从今天起归我巡。
lines.en: This wood is mine to patrol from today.

lines.zh: 我从叶底下爬出来，翅膀还湿。
lines.en: I crawl out. Wings still damp.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我在那儿。
lines.en: When you look up, I'm there.

lines.zh: 翅膀边缘一碰到火就卷了。
lines.en: Fire curled my wing edges.
Fell. Half a wing folded.
Wings wet. I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的粉全吹光了。
lines.en: The blast stripped every speck of dust.

lines.zh: 穿过翅膀的东西，留了个洞。
lines.en: Something punched a hole through my wing.
That light locked my wings.

lines.zh: 凋灵玫瑰没了，我在变淡。
lines.en: No wither roses. I'm thinning.

lines.zh: 雷光照得翅上的眼都白了。
lines.en: Lightning whitened the eyes on my wings.

lines.zh: 往下掉，翅膀越扇越没用。
lines.en: Falling. Beating my wings does less and less.
